category: hosted authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, social, passwordless and enterprise login)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: up to 25,000 monthly active users, unlimited social connections, 5 organizations, 1 enterprise connection, 1,000 machine-to-machine authentications, 1 tenant and 3 admins; no credit card needed to sign up
free_tier.notes: An MAU is a non-internal user that authenticated during a month for a given tenant. The Free plan is the same for B2C and B2B. It includes 1 custom domain, which needs credit card verification, and 5 Actions + Forms. Pro MFA factors and role management are not available on Free. Each account holds one free tenant at a time.

per_object_cap.stated: Auth0 states a user profile size limit of 10 KB, and writes over it succeed for now but may start to fail; user_metadata set through the Authentication API Signup endpoint takes at most 10 string fields of at most 500 characters each
per_object_cap.notes: The Management API List and Search Users endpoints index, query and return at most 1 MB of data per user.

retention.stated: Tenant logs are kept 1 day on Free; a Free tenant with no admin login, user login or API call for 150 days is deleted with all its data and cannot be recovered
retention.notes: Paid plans keep logs 5, 10 or 30 days. The inactivity rule is on the Auth0 support article and the data processing page.

egress.terms: not applicable: an authentication API; no traffic allowance or egress term is published

interface_detail: Authentication API (OAuth 2.0 and OIDC endpoints such as /oauth/token and /userinfo) and Management API v2 at https://{tenant}/api/v2/ with a Bearer token; both are served on the tenant's own domain.
tooling: Any HTTP client or OAuth 2.0 / OIDC library against the tenant's Authentication API and Management API v2.
chaining: An OIDC identity provider in front of apps on free compute; user import is included on Free, so users can be moved in through the Management API.

limits.value: Authentication API: 300 burst, 300 requests per minute sustained
Management API: 2 burst, 2 requests per second sustained
logs kept 1 day; a tenant inactive for 150 days is deleted
the custom domain needs credit card verification
user profile 10 KB (a soft limit: writes over it succeed for now but may start to fail)

binding_note: The Management API takes 2 requests a second on Free, so any bulk user administration is slow; sign-ins share the Authentication API's 300 requests a minute.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page asks for an email address, or a GitHub, Google or Microsoft sign-in, and states no credit card is required. After registration a profile page asks for an Account Type when the email domain is not a corporate one or for a Role when it is, and the user is asked to create a tenant, which takes a tenant name and a region. A custom domain needs credit card verification. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A Free tenant inactive for 150 days is deleted and cannot be recovered; Free support is community only.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from the first-party pricing page, rate-limit policy, data processing page, support article and sign-up page. No probe was run, because the API is served on a per-tenant domain. A token request on a Free tenant would move it to measured.
